name: Move data from eBay to Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **ebay** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **ebay** account using the **(+)** icon with your **credential name.** Read more about how to find these details [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/ebay/index.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/ebay/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
